name: Shorts & Reels Editor
tagline: Cuts raw footage into vertical shorts with the hook first and captions on
description: Give it your raw footage and it cuts a vertical short that opens with the hook instead of burying it, adds captions, and frames the shot so nothing you need stays hidden behind platform buttons. It keeps the quirks of each short-form app in mind, so one export survives TikTok, Reels, and Shorts without a re-edit.
author: Draggen75
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
